source_scope: Island of Hawaii (Hawaii County), not statewide

rights_ladder.state_program_terms_excerpt: The contents of this web page are public domain and to the extent indicated otherwise in the Terms of Use, are exempt from Terms of Use policy restrictions.
rights_ladder.state_program_scope_finding: The official downloadable-layer index has no statewide address-points/address-location product. Its Locations and Geodetic Networks section lists GeoID, Geographic Place Names, Mile Markers, and NGS Geodetic Control Stations; it does not list an address-point layer.

statewide_parcel_candidate.publisher: Hawaii Statewide GIS Program; source counties Hawaii, Honolulu, Kauai, Maui
statewide_parcel_candidate.reason_not_selected: The authoritative statewide layer contains TMK/parcel identifiers and polygon geometry, but no street address, house number, or geocoded address fields. It cannot satisfy OMEGA address coverage by itself.
statewide_parcel_candidate.source_count: not acquired because not an address-capable source

alternate_authoritative_address_candidat.scope: City and County of Honolulu only
alternate_authoritative_address_candidat.reason: Layer identifies Honolulu Land Information System / Department of Planning and Permitting as copyright holder and provides no affirmative commercial/open-reuse grant in the witnessed layer metadata.
Existing evidence captures county copyright text and no affirmative commercial/open-reuse grant.

rights_ladder.resolution: No exact statewide address-capable dataset was found under the Statewide GIS public-domain download program. The statewide TMK parcel layer is public-domain-program distributed but not address-capable; the two authoritative address-point alternatives are county-scoped and rights-unresolved.

permission_request.recipient: Hawaii Statewide GIS Program (gis@hawaii.gov), with copies to Honolulu DPP/HOLIS and county GIS authorities as applicable
permission_request.subject: Permission to use authoritative Hawaii address-point data for OMEGA non-mailing spatial operations
permission_request.body: OMEGA requests written confirmation that the authoritative address-point data published or supplied by the Hawaii Statewide GIS Program and/or participating county GIS agencies may be acquired, copied, canonicalized, deduplicated, combined with other address observations, retained with provenance, and used for commercial spatial intelligence, mapping, routing, and field operations. OMEGA will not create or export mailing lists from the data. Please identify the exact dataset/service, contributor chain, attribution requirements, redistribution/derived-work limits, and any state/county restrictions.
permission_request.activation_after_clearance: Capture signed/authoritative terms, fingerprint exact source, then run the existing generic ArcGIS/file connector and HI reconciliation; do not change NAD.

next_activation: Only after affirmative rights evidence for an exact address-capable source or authoritative permission; then run existing generic connector and HI reconciliation.
